name: Devon Akins
headline: Software Systems Builder · Mathematics Tutor · Independent Researcher
profileHeadline: Founder of ANEVUM · Software Builder · Mathematics Tutor
summary: Software builder, mathematics tutor, and independent researcher with experience spanning software development, undergraduate biophysics research, mathematics instruction, and organization leadership. Founded ANEVUM in 2026 as an independent software studio, combining React and TypeScript interfaces, Python services, data systems, cloud deployment, quantitative research, and technical documentation to build practical products and experiments.

bullets: Founded and operate an independent software studio building web products, automation, quantitative research systems, and technical publishing.
Design and ship React and TypeScript interfaces and Python/FastAPI services from product concept through production deployment.
Build SQLite/PostgreSQL data pipelines, telemetry, evidence capture, reconciliation, and operational tooling.
Manage cloud deployment and reliability workflows across Railway, Cloudflare, Docker, and GitHub Actions.
Conduct quantitative research, simulation, validation, and documentation to move defensible ideas from experiment to production.
Provide one-on-one mathematics instruction tailored to each student's coursework, pace, and learning needs.
Develop individualized explanations, worked examples, practice plans, and study strategies for subjects from algebra through calculus and statistics.
Translate abstract mathematical concepts into clear step-by-step reasoning and adapt instruction from student feedback and performance.
Contributed to biophysics and neural-systems research related to the Criticality Hypothesis.
Supported computational and theoretical analysis, data review, literature research, and research documentation.
Participated in lab discussions and communicated technical findings and open questions to support ongoing research.
Founded and led a student organization centered on mathematics, science, collaborative study, and academic community.
Coordinated study sessions, educational events, outreach, scheduling, and member communication.
Built the organization from concept through day-to-day operations while balancing university coursework and research.

education.detail: Relevant coursework includes Calculus II, Calculus III, and Linear Algebra.

systems.name: IREN

systems.name: RHEN
systems.description: Flagship trading and research system for market observation, risk, execution, reconciliation, canonical telemetry, evidence, replay, forecasting, and long-only U.S. equities and ETF operation.

systems.name: NOSTRA
systems.description: Forecasting module inside RHEN for regimes, forward horizons, uncertainty, calibration, scoring, and post-event outcomes.

systems.name: GRAEN
systems.description: Research module and mathematical program inside RHEN for methodology, falsification, selection bias, multiplicity, dependence, and validation.

systems.name: VELUM
systems.description: Broker-isolated replay and simulation module inside RHEN for reconstruction, counterfactual analysis, validation, and reproducible testing.

systems.name: ANEVUM Web

timeline.title: Canonical RHEN telemetry
timeline.detail: Built durable decision, order, position, incident, provenance, and account-state telemetry as the evidence backbone for live and research workflows.

timeline.title: RHEN live production

timeline.title: Research operations
timeline.detail: Added Research Agent and Agent Support foundations, pre-open research state, durable research decisions, and scheduler/readiness controls.

timeline.title: GRAEN validation program
